build_net_model: build a PyTorch Net model with shared and private MLP branches for adversarial continual learning
create_private_module: create a Private module with per-task linear layers that map input to a latent dimension
create_shared_module: create a Shared module with configurable 2 or 3 layer MLP for shared feature extraction
run_forward_pass: run a forward pass through Net using shared and private features concatenated for task classification
get_encoded_features: get encoded features from both the shared and private branches for a given task
